{{< include ../../_extensions/r-wasm/live/_knitr.qmd >}}

Welcome to the **Projection Diffusion Animator**, a serverless tool for creating
animations that transition your spatial data from expression space (e.g. UMAP)
to physical space (XY coordinates). 

This tool utilizes WebAssembly [(WebR)](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/){target="_blank"} and [ObservableJS](https://quarto.org/docs/interactive/ojs/){target="_blank"} to run entirely in your web browser without uploading data to a remote server. 

You can explore one of our own examples or load your own. 

Advanced users should check out the `Advanced`
tab if they want to customize their aesthetics plot even further or download 
the underlying plotting functions for use locally. 

::: {.callout-warning appearance="simple"}
**Beta Notice:** This dashboard is currently in an **experimental / beta testing phase**. Features, performance, and data formats are subject to change. When you first load the site, you will see temporary `
OJS Runtime Error` messages displayed until data are initialized. Please report any issues you encounter.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false

duck_db_client = {
  const duckdb = await import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@duckdb/duckdb-wasm@1.28.0/+esm");
  
  console.log("🔧 Initializing DuckDB-Wasm Client...");
  
  const JSDELIVR_BUNDLES = duckdb.getJsDelivrBundles();
  const bundle = await duckdb.selectBundle(JSDELIVR_BUNDLES);
  
  const worker_url = URL.createObjectURL(
    new Blob([`importScripts("${bundle.mainWorker}");`], { type: "text/javascript" })
  );

  const worker = new Worker(worker_url);
  const logger = new duckdb.ConsoleLogger();
  const db = new duckdb.AsyncDuckDB(logger, worker);
  
  await db.instantiate(bundle.mainModule, bundle.pthreadWorker);
  
  const conn = await db.connect();
  conn.instance = db; // Attach the engine to the connection
  console.log("✅ DuckDB-Wasm Ready (Engine + Connection)");
  return conn;
}
```

<!-- Processes a user's data into parquet format and returns reference list -->
```{webr}
#| echo: false
#| autorun: true
#| output: false
#| input: 
#|   - new_user_data
#| define: 
#|   - processed_new_data

processed_new_data <- NULL

if(length(new_user_data) > 1){
  cat(paste0("Processing new user data. Timestamp: ", Sys.time()))
  
  user_file_name <- as.character(new_user_data$filename)
  ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(user_file_name))
  target_dir <- as.character(new_user_data$id)
  dir.create(target_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  target_file <- file.path(target_dir, 
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(user_file_name), ".parquet"))
  
  if(ext=="parquet"){
    # if already a parquet, just need to write it.
    writeBin(as.raw(new_user_data$data), target_file)
  } else {
    # 1. Write the raw bytes to a temporary file in the virtual filesystem
    tmp_raw_path <- file.path(target_dir, user_file_name)
    writeBin(as.raw(new_user_data$data), tmp_raw_path)
    
    # 2. Use DuckDB to convert the CSV/TSV to Parquet
    # 'read_csv_auto' automatically detects headers and delimiters (comma vs tab)
    query <- sprintf(
      "COPY (SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto('%s')) TO '%s' (FORMAT 'PARQUET')", 
      tmp_raw_path, 
      target_file
    )
    
    tryCatch({
      dbExecute(con, query)
      cat("\nSuccessfully converted to Parquet via DuckDB.")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("\nError during conversion: ", e$message)
    })
    
    # 3. Clean up the temporary raw file to save virtual memory
    unlink(tmp_raw_path)
  }
  
  new_result_list <- list(
      id = target_dir,
      name = user_file_name,
      description = "User Uploaded Data", 

      url_data = target_file,
      type = "local",
      valid = TRUE
    )
    
    processed_new_data <- as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(new_result_list, auto_unbox = TRUE))
  
  
} else {
  cat(paste0("new_user_data is NA. Timestamp: ", Sys.time()))
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false

//| echo: false
//| output: false

study_data_payload = {
  const selection = selected_study;
  const rate = sample_rate; 
  if (!selection) return null;

  // --- LOCAL MODE ---
  if (selection.type === "local") {
    console.log("👉 Mode: Local (VFS Path)");
    return { 
      mode: "local", 
      name: selection.name, 
      payload: selection.url_data, // The path string in the VFS
      rate: rate 
    };
  }

  // --- REMOTE MODE ---
  if (selection.type === "remote") {
    console.log("👉 Mode: Remote (JS Bridge)");
    try {
      const conn = await duck_db_client;
      const sql = `
        SELECT * FROM read_parquet('${selection.url_data}') 
        USING SAMPLE ${rate} PERCENT (bernoulli)
      `;
      const result = await conn.query(sql);
      const sampled_json = result.toArray().map(row => row.toJSON());

      return {
        mode: "remote_js_bridge",
        name: selection.name,
        payload: sampled_json, // The actual sampled data rows
        rate: rate
      };
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("❌ JS Bridge Error:", e);
      return null;
    }
  }
}
```



:::

<!-- Actually pulls in the data into webR; prints the number of rows. -->
```{webr}
#| echo: false
#| autorun: true
#| input:
#|   - study_data_payload

df_main <- data.frame()

if (!is.null(study_data_payload)) {
  # cat(paste0("Processing: ", study_data_payload$name, "\n"))
  
  if (study_data_payload$mode == "remote_js_bridge") {
    # payload = list of rows from JS
    df_main <- jsonlite::fromJSON(jsonlite::toJSON(study_data_payload$payload))
    
  } else {
    # payload = VFS file path string
    query <- sprintf(
      "SELECT * FROM '%s' USING SAMPLE %f PERCENT (bernoulli)", 
      study_data_payload$payload, 
      as.numeric(study_data_payload$rate)
    )
    
    tryCatch({
      df_main <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("❌ Local Query Error: ", e$message)
    })
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("✅ Active Dataset: %s (%d rows)\n", 
              study_data_payload$name, nrow(df_main)))
}
```
